title: TorchCode: Think of this as LeetCode specifically for PyTorch
description:
If you want to master AI engineering, you need TorchCode. Think of this as LeetCode specifically for PyTorch. It provides a guided practice environment where you are tasked with implementing neural network operators and complex architectures entirely from scratch. With automated grading and instant feedback, it is the absolute best way to deeply understand the math and code behind modern AI.

https://github.com/duoan/TorchCode
